results.title: U.N. General Assembly endorses a new world map that represents Africa more accurately in its larger size. Only the U.S. voted against it
results.description: The vote encourages governments and institutions around the world to replace the traditional Mercator map, commonly used since the 16th Century, with the Equal Earth projection.
